description: This file defines the static class RequestContext, which manages request-specific data propagation in Orleans. It provides mechanisms for storing, retrieving, and removing contextual data across asynchronous calls, specifically handling reentrancy identifiers and custom key-value pairs. The class is intended to be used within the Orleans runtime framework to support request flow and reentrancy control.

classes.name: RequestContext
classes.description: A static class managing request-specific context data, including reentrancy IDs and user-defined key-value pairs, propagated across asynchronous calls within the Orleans runtime.

classes.name: RequestContext.ContextProperties
classes.description: Immutable struct encapsulating a dictionary of context values, used internally within RequestContext.

classes.name: RequestContext.ReentrancySection
classes.description: A struct implementing IDisposable, managing the scope and lifecycle of reentrancy states during request processing.

methods.name: ReentrancySection
methods.description: Constructor initializing reentrancy scope, calls appropriate grain methods on enter and exit if applicable.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the reentrancy scope, restoring previous state and notifying the grain context.
